title: Identity comparison on the restricted coherent tower
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, W a scheme with l invertible, D a PodCompletionReindex for the identity, and a an ordinary inverse-image isomorphism to identity with the Over.mapId section formula. Assume only D.RestrictedGenerators. For every coherent-system cochain complex C, D.restricted(C) followed by coefficient restriction of the ordinary system identity equals the tower of degreewise components of a. This is an equality of strict tower maps before Roos realization or localization. The constructions and notation are those of [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems].

source.place: Steps 1 and 5: identity and composition of the normalized quotient, Roos-limit and tensor transport.

proof.text: Evaluate the restricted map on the canonical section casts, which are bijective. Apply RestrictedGenerators, commute coefficient restriction with the system identity component using its section formula, and use naturality along the comma arrow. The ordinary system-unit formula reduces the composite to restriction along Over.mapId. This is precisely the section formula for a. Extensionality in the site object, cochain degree and tower index identifies the whole strict tower maps.

mathlib_searches.query: A map of mapping cones is determined by both coordinate projections and naturality of products under an isomorphism to the identity functor
mathlib_searches.results: Found mappingCone.ext_to and ext_to_iff, map and mapHomologicalComplexXIso_eq. These give coordinate extensionality, not the section-normalized identity on these strict coefficient towers.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use coordinate extensionality to prove the Roos step; no exact project-specific identity found.

theorem podIdentityRestrictedTower
    (W : Scheme.{u}) [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E (𝟙 W))
    (hD : PodCompletionReindex.RestrictedGenerators l E (𝟙 W) D)
    (a : isoReductionIntegralInverse l E (𝟙 W) ≅ 𝟭 _)
    (ha : ∀ (M : scalarReductionSource l E W) (U : W.ProEt)
      (x : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose (𝟙 W)).obj U))),
      (a.hom.app M).val.app (op U) x =
        M.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.mapId (P := @WeaklyEtale) ⊤ W
          (𝟙 W) rfl).hom.app U).op x)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E W) ℤ) :
    let α := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex a (.up ℤ) ≪≫
      Functor.mapHomologicalComplexIdIso _ (.up ℤ)
    let σ := NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralComparisonSequenceUnit l E W) (.up ℤ) ≪≫
      Functor.mapHomologicalComplexIdIso _ (.up ℤ)
    (D.restricted C).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map
        (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
          (σ.hom.app C)) =
      (isoWhiskerLeft (podRestrictedTower l E C) α ≪≫
        (podRestrictedTower l E C).rightUnitor).hom
